purpose: Canonical evidence shard for LORE Crypto History. Only independently scoreable verified events are included; context and merged discovery rows remain in reconciliation.
note: 2020 fully reconciled from 115 discovery rows into 71 canonical events. Cross-year corrections, context and duplicates are excluded from independent scoring.

events.title: Aave becomes a major decentralized lending protocol
events.summary: Aave V1 launched in January 2020 after the ETHLend team rebuilt its peer-to-peer lending model around pooled liquidity.
events.significance: Aave became one of DeFi's dominant lending protocols and helped popularize flash loans and pooled money markets.

sources.title: Aave Labs — historical contributions / Aave V1

events.title: Curve launches stablecoin-focused AMM
events.summary: Curve launched in early 2020 as an automated market maker optimized for efficient trading between stablecoins.
events.significance: Its specialized invariant made stablecoin swaps cheaper and less price-sensitive and established Curve as core DeFi liquidity infrastructure.

sources.title: Curve — The Rise of the Home of Stablecoins

events.title: Aave V1 launches with Flash Loans
events.summary: Aave V1 launched in January 2020 and introduced Flash Loans as a core protocol feature.
events.significance: Aave's flash loans became one of DeFi's most distinctive programmable-finance primitives and helped define the new possibilities and risks of composable lending.

events.title: bZx flash-loan attacks expose composability risks
events.summary: bZx suffered two flash-loan-enabled attacks within days, exploiting interactions across lending, trading and oracle systems.
events.significance: The attacks became the canonical early demonstration that DeFi composability could create new attack surfaces without compromising the underlying blockchains.

events.title: Decentraland opens its public virtual world
events.summary: Decentraland opened its public virtual world on 20 February 2020, transferring key governance and content control toward its community.
events.significance: The launch created one of crypto's most prominent blockchain-native virtual worlds and became central to the later metaverse-land boom.

events.title: Solana mainnet beta launches
events.summary: Solana initialized its Mainnet Beta with a global validator community in March 2020.
events.significance: Solana introduced a high-throughput alternative smart-contract architecture that later became one of the largest non-Ethereum crypto ecosystems.

events.title: India Supreme Court overturns central-bank crypto banking restriction
events.summary: India's Supreme Court set aside the RBI's 2018 circular that had prohibited regulated entities from providing banking services to crypto businesses.
events.significance: The decision reopened banking access to India's crypto sector and became a landmark judicial check on a central-bank restriction.

sources.title: Supreme Court of India — IAMAI v RBI judgment

events.title: COVID Black Thursday crypto crash
events.summary: During the global COVID-19 market panic, Bitcoin fell violently alongside traditional risk assets, dropping below $6,000 and later below $5,000 during the wider selloff.
events.significance: Black Thursday shattered the idea that Bitcoin would automatically behave as a crisis hedge and simultaneously stress-tested DeFi liquidation systems.

events.title: MakerDAO Black Thursday produces emergency governance
events.summary: MakerDAO suffered severe liquidation stress during Black Thursday as collateral prices collapsed and congestion impaired keepers, producing zero-bid auctions and protocol bad debt.
events.significance: The crisis became DeFi's first major systemic stress test and forced emergency governance, risk changes and new collateral choices.

events.title: Nifty Gateway 2.0 launches fiat-friendly NFT marketplace
events.summary: Nifty Gateway 2.0 launched as a USD-based NFT marketplace using Gemini custody and bank/card-friendly payment flows.
events.significance: Its curated drops and fiat-friendly buying experience helped bring crypto art and NFTs to collectors who did not already use self-custody wallets.

sources.title: Nifty Gateway — Launch of Nifty Gateway 2.0

events.title: Hive launches as community fork of Steem
events.summary: Hive launched as a community-driven hard fork of Steem, mirroring eligible account balances and content while excluding selected Steemit-controlled stake from the initial airdrop.
events.significance: The fork became one of crypto's clearest examples of a community using a chain split to escape a governance struggle over concentrated stake and control.

sources.title: Hive — Announcing the Launch of Hive Blockchain

events.title: Libra redesigns its payment system after regulatory backlash
events.summary: The Libra Association published an updated White Paper v2.0 that moved away from the original single global-currency design toward single-currency stablecoins and stronger compliance controls.
events.significance: The redesign showed how aggressively government and central-bank scrutiny reshaped Facebook's private-money ambitions.

sources.title: Diem Association — Libra developers: The path forward

events.title: Paul Tudor Jones publicly reveals Bitcoin allocation
events.summary: Hedge-fund manager Paul Tudor Jones publicly said he held a little over 1% of his assets in Bitcoin, potentially near 2%, after earlier describing Bitcoin futures as an inflation hedge.
events.significance: A celebrated macro investor publicly allocating to Bitcoin was an important bridge between crypto-native markets and traditional macro investing.

sources.title: The Block — Paul Tudor Jones holds 1–2% in Bitcoin

events.title: Third Bitcoin halving
events.summary: At block 630,000, Bitcoin's block subsidy fell from 12.5 BTC to 6.25 BTC.
events.significance: The third halving reinforced Bitcoin's programmed scarcity just months before the institutional treasury-adoption wave.

events.title: Telegram abandons original TON project after SEC court battle
events.summary: Telegram founder Pavel Durov announced that Telegram was ending its involvement in the original TON blockchain after a US court blocked the planned Gram distribution.
events.significance: The shutdown showed that even a globally distributed technology project backed by a huge private token raise could be stopped by securities enforcement.

sources.title: Pavel Durov — What Was TON And Why It Is Over

events.title: Uniswap V2 launches
events.summary: Uniswap v2 deployed to Ethereum mainnet with arbitrary ERC-20/ERC-20 pairs, flash swaps and improved oracle functionality.
events.significance: V2 turned Uniswap from an elegant proof of concept into a major decentralized exchange and the platform targeted by SushiSwap's vampire attack.

events.title: Dormant February 2009 Bitcoin moves after eleven years
events.summary: Fifty BTC mined in February 2009 moved after more than eleven years of dormancy. Contemporary analysis said there was little evidence the coins belonged to Satoshi Nakamoto.
events.significance: The transfer became classic Bitcoin mystery lore because any movement of very early coins can trigger speculation about Satoshi-era miners.
events.notes: Do not imply the wallet belonged to Satoshi; contemporary chain analysis argued otherwise.

events.title: Polkadot mainnet launch establishes relay-chain architecture
events.summary: Web3 Foundation launched the initial version of Polkadot on 26 May 2020.
events.significance: Polkadot became a major multi-chain architecture built around shared security and interoperability.

events.title: Compound launches COMP liquidity mining
events.summary: Compound began distributing COMP governance tokens to protocol users who supplied or borrowed assets.
events.significance: The distribution ignited the liquidity-mining and yield-farming boom that defined DeFi Summer.

events.title: Polymarket launches
events.summary: Polymarket's own September 2020 post states that it launched its beta out of stealth on 16 June 2020.
events.significance: The platform became the most prominent crypto-native prediction market of the mid-2020s and a major bridge between on-chain markets and mainstream political/news forecasting.

sources.title: Polymarket — Stage 2 announcement recalling June 16 beta launch

events.title: Ledger customer-data breach exposes hardware-wallet buyers
events.summary: An attacker accessed Ledger's e-commerce and marketing database in June 2020. Ledger disclosed the breach in July; a large customer database containing emails and detailed contact information later became public in December.
events.significance: The breach did not expose hardware-wallet private keys, but it created a lasting physical-security and phishing risk for self-custody users.

sources.title: Ledger — Addressing the July 2020 data breach
Ledger CEO message on data leak

events.title: Philippines SEC moves against Forsage
events.summary: The Philippines Securities and Exchange Commission warned on 30 June that Forsage was unregistered and unauthorized to solicit investments, then publicized a cease-and-desist order in September.
events.significance: The action was an early regulatory confrontation with a smart-contract-based pyramid-style investment scheme.

sources.title: Philippines SEC — cease and desist against Forsage

events.title: Rarible launches RARI governance token
events.summary: After roughly six months of marketplace operation, Rarible announced the RARI governance token and a plan to distribute it to marketplace participants.
events.significance: RARI brought DeFi-style liquidity mining and tokenized governance into the NFT marketplace sector before the 2021 NFT boom.

events.title: Twitter celebrity-account hack requests Bitcoin payments
events.summary: Attackers compromised around 130 high-profile Twitter accounts and used some to promote a Bitcoin doubling scam.
events.significance: The incident put a crypto scam onto accounts belonging to some of the world's most recognizable politicians, celebrities and companies.

events.title: Sorare raises $4M for fantasy-football NFTs
events.summary: Sorare announced a $4 million seed round led by e.ventures to expand its officially licensed fantasy-football game built around scarce Ethereum player cards.
events.significance: The round was an important early validation of sports NFTs and blockchain fantasy gaming before the 2021 NFT boom.

events.title: YFI and Yearn become emblematic of DeFi Summer
events.summary: Andre Cronje launched the YFI governance token with no pre-mine, investor sale or founder allocation, distributing the initial 30,000 tokens through liquidity provision.
events.significance: YFI became the defining 'fair launch' of DeFi Summer and helped turn yield optimization into a community-governed movement.

events.title: US OCC allows national banks to provide crypto custody services
events.summary: The US Office of the Comptroller of the Currency clarified that national banks and federal savings associations may provide cryptocurrency custody services.
events.significance: The interpretation opened a formal route for federally chartered banks to hold cryptographic keys and offer crypto custody.

sources.title: OCC — national banks may provide crypto custody

events.title: Cardano Shelley introduces staking
events.summary: Cardano transitioned from Byron to the Shelley era, introducing stake pools, delegation and the path toward decentralized block production.
events.significance: Shelley was Cardano's defining proof-of-stake decentralization milestone.

events.title: Grayscale television ads market crypto to mainstream investors
events.summary: Grayscale launched a national television advertising campaign encouraging investors to move toward digital currencies through its investment products.
events.significance: The campaign was a vivid mainstream-marketing moment in the institutionalization of crypto investment products.

sources.title: The Block — Grayscale national advertising campaign

events.title: MicroStrategy adopts a Bitcoin treasury strategy
events.summary: MicroStrategy announced it had purchased 21,454 BTC for $250 million and adopted Bitcoin as its primary treasury reserve asset.
events.significance: The move created the modern corporate Bitcoin treasury playbook and turned a public operating company into a leveraged proxy for Bitcoin exposure.

sources.title: SEC filing — MicroStrategy adopts Bitcoin treasury reserve

events.title: Yam Finance rapid rise and bug become DeFi Summer lore
events.summary: Yam Finance launched after roughly ten days of development, rapidly attracted hundreds of millions of dollars of staked assets and then disclosed a critical rebase/governance bug.
events.significance: YAM became the perfect symbol of DeFi Summer's speed, experimental 'food token' culture and smart-contract risk.

events.title: CRV and Curve governance launch
events.summary: CRV launched and Curve's DAO/governance system came online in August 2020.
events.significance: CRV emissions and vote-escrow governance later created one of DeFi's most important liquidity-incentive and governance economies.

sources.title: Curve — The Rise of the Home of Stablecoins

events.title: FTX acquires Blockfolio
events.summary: FTX acquired the Blockfolio portfolio-tracking app in a deal valued at about $150 million, aiming to expand from professional derivatives into the retail market.
events.significance: The acquisition foreshadowed FTX's push for mass-market users and its rapid expansion before the 2022 collapse.

events.title: SushiSwap vampire attack
events.summary: SushiSwap launched as a Uniswap fork with SUSHI liquidity-mining incentives and then migrated more than $800 million of liquidity away from Uniswap in a 'vampire attack.'
events.significance: The episode became a defining demonstration of permissionless forks, liquidity incentives and community-owned protocol competition.

events.title: CipherTrace claims new Monero tracing capabilities
events.summary: CipherTrace announced what it called the world's first Monero tracing tools for law enforcement and virtual-asset service providers, developed under a US Department of Homeland Security contract.
events.significance: The announcement sparked debate over the practical traceability of privacy coins; the capability should be presented as CipherTrace's claim, not as proof that Monero privacy was fully broken.
events.notes: Always attribute the tracing claim to CipherTrace.

events.title: Serum launches on Solana with FTX backing
events.summary: Serum launched on Solana as an open-source decentralized exchange protocol built around an on-chain central limit order book, with backing from FTX, Alameda Research and the Solana Foundation.
events.significance: Serum became foundational Solana trading infrastructure and later a major example of ecosystem dependency on FTX-linked institutions.

events.title: Avalanche mainnet launches
events.summary: Avalanche launched its mainnet in September 2020.
events.significance: Avalanche became a major smart-contract and subnet ecosystem built around the Avalanche consensus family.

events.title: Chef Nomi sells SUSHI treasury tokens and later returns funds
events.summary: Chef Nomi sold developer-fund tokens amid accusations of a rug pull, handed control to Sam Bankman-Fried and later returned funds.
events.significance: The founder drama made SushiSwap one of the most chaotic and memorable governance stories of DeFi Summer.

events.title: Flow beta mainnet goes live with NBA Top Shot in production
events.summary: Dapper Labs reported that Flow beta mainnet was live by September 2020 with NBA Top Shot already running in production.
events.significance: Flow was purpose-built for consumer-scale digital collectibles and became the blockchain behind NBA Top Shot and other major entertainment partnerships.
events.notes: Current primary source establishes September 2020 beta-mainnet status but not a single exact activation day.

events.title: Swiss Parliament adopts DLT legal reforms
events.summary: The Swiss Parliament adopted the Federal Act on the Adaptation of Federal Law to Developments in Distributed Ledger Technology on 25 September 2020.
events.significance: The reforms created a legal framework for blockchain-based assets and infrastructure.

sources.title: Swiss SIF — Limitation on ombudsman affiliation requirement
sources.supports: Explicitly records Parliament's adoption date as 25 September 2020.

sources.title: Swiss SIF — DLT / blockchain / tokenisation
sources.supports: Partial commencement on 1 February 2021 and full DLT Act/ordinance commencement on 1 August 2021.

events.notes: Adoption is a 2020 event; commencement is 2021. Do not describe all provisions as already in force in September 2020.

events.title: Binance Smart Chain launches
events.summary: Binance Smart Chain launched mainnet as an EVM-compatible blockchain using BNB for fees and staking.
events.significance: BSC created a low-cost smart-contract ecosystem closely linked to Binance and became a major venue for retail DeFi activity in 2021.

sources.title: Binance — Binance Smart Chain Mainnet Launch
BNB Chain — Binance Smart Chain Mainnet Launch

events.title: Uniswap distributes UNI in a landmark airdrop
events.summary: Uniswap launched the UNI governance token and allocated 15% of the genesis supply for immediate distribution to historical users and liquidity providers.
events.significance: The airdrop became the canonical retroactive token distribution and reset competitive dynamics after SushiSwap's attack.

events.title: PlusToken organizers are prosecuted in China
events.summary: Chinese courts convicted key PlusToken organizers in 2020; an appellate ruling reported in November upheld sentences ranging up to 11 years for organizers of the large crypto-linked pyramid scheme.
events.significance: The prosecutions were a major law-enforcement outcome for one of the largest crypto investment frauds associated with the 2019 market.

events.title: Synthetix goes live on Optimistic Ethereum L2 testnet
events.summary: Synthetix announced that SNX staking was live on an incentivized Optimistic Ethereum Layer 2 testnet.
events.significance: This was an important public test of a generalized optimistic-rollup design with a major live DeFi protocol before L2 mainnets opened broadly in 2021.

events.title: KuCoin suffers a major exchange hack
events.summary: KuCoin disclosed a security incident in which private keys to hot wallets were compromised and crypto assets were transferred out without authorization.
events.significance: The hack became one of 2020's largest centralized-exchange thefts and a major case study in recovery, token freezes and exchange coordination.

events.title: Coinbase mission statement limits employee political activism and sparks debate
events.summary: Brian Armstrong published Coinbase's 'mission focused' policy on 27 September, saying the company would avoid broader political and social activism at work; Coinbase then offered exit packages to employees who disagreed with the direction.
events.significance: The policy became one of the crypto industry's most visible workplace-culture controversies and influenced later debates about corporate political neutrality.

sources.title: Coinbase — Coinbase is a mission focused company
Coinbase — follow up to mission focused company

events.title: MetaMask surpasses one million monthly active users
events.summary: MetaMask surpassed one million monthly active users in October 2020 after growing more than fourfold in a year, with DeFi cited as a major driver.
events.significance: The milestone showed that self-custodial browser wallets had become a mass gateway into Ethereum applications.

sources.title: Consensys — MetaMask surpasses 5M MAUs (retrospective includes Oct 2020 milestone)

events.title: Wormhole launches the first Solana–Ethereum token bridge
events.summary: The Solana Foundation and Certus One announced Wormhole in October 2020 as a bidirectional Solana–Ethereum token bridge; Wormhole's later official roadmap describes the bridge as launching in 2020.
events.significance: Wormhole became foundational cross-chain infrastructure for Solana and later one of the industry's most important interoperability protocols.
events.notes: The Oct. 7 announcement described testnet/hackathon availability; Wormhole's own later roadmap confirms the bridge launched in 2020.

events.title: US authorities bring major enforcement action against BitMEX
events.summary: The CFTC sued BitMEX entities and founders over alleged unregistered derivatives operations and AML failures, while US prosecutors separately charged four executives with Bank Secrecy Act offenses.
events.significance: The coordinated action was a watershed enforcement event for offshore crypto derivatives platforms.

events.title: Square purchases Bitcoin for its corporate treasury
events.summary: Square announced the purchase of approximately 4,709 BTC for $50 million, about 1% of its assets at the time.
events.significance: Square's purchase reinforced the emerging idea that public technology companies could hold Bitcoin on their balance sheets.

events.title: Shenzhen runs a major public digital-yuan pilot
events.summary: Shenzhen ran a large public digital-renminbi pilot, distributing 10 million yuan through 50,000 digital red envelopes usable at designated merchants; official results reported 47,573 recipients and 62,788 transactions during the test window.
events.significance: The Shenzhen trial was one of the clearest early public demonstrations of China's central-bank digital currency at consumer scale.

sources.title: Shenzhen Government — digital RMB red-envelope pilot
Shenzhen Government — digital RMB pilot results

events.title: Stone Ridge discloses 10,000+ BTC treasury as NYDIG expands
events.summary: NYDIG announced a $50 million growth-equity raise while parent Stone Ridge Holdings Group disclosed that it had purchased more than 10,000 BTC, then worth more than $100 million, as a primary treasury reserve asset.
events.significance: The announcement combined institutional custody infrastructure with another large corporate treasury allocation during Bitcoin's 2020 institutional turn.

sources.title: NYDIG — Stone Ridge treasury Bitcoin and $50M funding

events.title: Ethereum publishes mainnet staking deposit address and Launch Pad
events.summary: The Ethereum Foundation released the v1.0 proof-of-stake specifications, published the mainnet deposit-contract address and said the mainnet Launch Pad was available.
events.significance: This opened the publicly announced staking onboarding milestone ahead of Beacon Chain genesis.

sources.title: Ethereum Foundation / Danny Ryan — eth2 quick update no. 19
sources.supports: 4 November publication of the mainnet deposit address, v1.0 specification and Launch Pad.

sources.title: Ethereum.org — Timeline of all Ethereum forks: staking deposit contract deployed
sources.supports: Distinguishes deployment on 14 October 2020 at 09:22:52 UTC, block 11052984, from the 4 November public announcement.

events.notes: The previous 14 October date referred to contract deployment. It is not the date of this public announcement. Deployment, announcement, threshold and 1 December genesis must remain distinct.

milestones.event: Public mainnet deposit-address and Launch Pad announcement

events.title: Filecoin mainnet launches decentralized storage market
events.summary: Filecoin mainnet went live around 15:00 UTC on 15 October 2020.
events.significance: Filecoin created a live token-incentivized decentralized storage marketplace after one of the ICO era's largest fundraises.

events.title: Bahamas launches the Sand Dollar CBDC
events.summary: The Central Bank of The Bahamas began national rollout of the Sand Dollar, a digital version of the Bahamian dollar.
events.significance: The Sand Dollar became the first widely recognized fully deployed central-bank digital currency at national scale.

sources.title: Central Bank of Bahamas — Sand Dollar rollout

events.title: PayPal announces cryptocurrency support
events.summary: PayPal announced a service allowing US users to buy, hold and sell Bitcoin, Ether, Bitcoin Cash and Litecoin, with plans to use crypto as a funding source at merchants.
events.significance: PayPal brought direct crypto access to a vast mainstream payments user base and signaled a major fintech shift toward digital assets.

events.title: JPM Coin begins commercial use
events.summary: JPMorgan said JPM Coin had entered commercial use with a large international technology client for cross-border payments and created the Onyx blockchain business unit.
events.significance: A major global bank moving its own blockchain-based deposit representation into real commercial payments was a key institutional tokenization milestone.

sources.title: The Block — JPM Coin ready for commercial use / Onyx

events.title: FTX launches tokenized-stock trading outside the United States
events.summary: FTX introduced 24/7 fractional tokenized-stock trading for equities including Tesla, Apple and Amazon through partnerships with CM-Equity and Digital Assets AG; the service was unavailable to US users.
events.significance: The product blurred crypto exchange trading with traditional equities and foreshadowed the later tokenized-real-world-asset market.

sources.title: The Block — FTX launches 24/7 tokenized-stock trading

events.title: Flashbots forms to address MEV and transaction-ordering issues
events.summary: Flashbots emerged in 2020 to address miner/maximal extractable value; its initial architecture and MEV-geth work were made public in November before the later Flashbots Alpha launch.
events.significance: Flashbots turned MEV from a largely hidden transaction-ordering problem into an explicit research and infrastructure field for Ethereum.

events.title: ShapeShift delists Monero, Zcash and Dash over regulatory risk
events.summary: ShapeShift removed Monero, Zcash and Dash from its trading platform, with the company saying the delistings were intended to reduce regulatory risk.
events.significance: The delisting was an early high-profile sign that privacy-focused crypto assets faced increasing access pressure from regulated or compliance-conscious trading platforms.

sources.title: CoinDesk — ShapeShift delists privacy coins for regulatory risk

events.title: Yearn launches a rapid DeFi merger and collaboration spree
events.summary: Yearn announced a rapid sequence of integrations/merger-style collaborations with Pickle Finance, Cream Finance, Cover Protocol, Akropolis and SushiSwap; SushiSwap was described as the fifth such deal on 1 December.
events.significance: The spree was an unusual experiment in protocol-to-protocol consolidation and shared development without conventional corporate mergers.

sources.title: The Block — Yearn announces fifth merger, with SushiSwap

events.title: US government seizes a large cache of Silk Road-linked Bitcoin
events.summary: US authorities seized approximately 69,370 BTC linked to funds stolen from Silk Road and filed a civil forfeiture complaint days later.
events.significance: At the time it was the largest cryptocurrency seizure announced by the US Department of Justice and added a huge new government Bitcoin holding.

sources.title: DOJ — November 2020 Silk Road-linked Bitcoin seizure

events.title: PayPal enables crypto purchases for US users
events.summary: PayPal later announced that all eligible US account holders could buy, hold and sell supported cryptocurrencies.
events.significance: This was the consumer rollout phase of the canonical PayPal crypto announcement.

events.title: Art Blocks launches generative on-chain art platform
events.summary: Art Blocks launched with Snowfro's Chromie Squiggle collection on 27 November 2020.
events.significance: Art Blocks established a platform for generative art created and minted on-chain and became one of the defining institutions of the NFT art movement.

events.title: MassMutual announces $100 million Bitcoin purchase
events.summary: NYDIG announced that MassMutual had bought $100 million in Bitcoin for its general investment account and a separate $5 million equity stake in NYDIG.
events.significance: The purchase extended the 2020 institutional-adoption story into insurance-company investment accounts.

sources.title: NYDIG — Institutional Bitcoin Provider NYDIG Announces Minority Stake Purchase by MassMutual
sources.supports: Purchase amounts, account purpose, NYDIG facilitation/custody and public announcement date.

events.notes: Date is public announcement. The release says the purchase had occurred, without giving an execution day. Bitcoin purchase and NYDIG equity investment are different transactions.

events.title: Libra project rebrands to Diem
events.summary: The Libra Association renamed itself the Diem Association on 1 December 2020.
events.significance: The rebrand symbolized the project's attempt to distance itself from the controversy surrounding the original Libra proposal.

sources.title: Diem Association — economics/reserve note on Dec. 1 rename

events.title: Ethereum Beacon Chain launches
events.summary: Ethereum's Beacon Chain produced its genesis block on 1 December 2020 and began running proof-of-stake consensus alongside the existing proof-of-work chain.
events.significance: The Beacon Chain was the decisive live precursor to Ethereum's 2022 Merge.

events.title: The Graph mainnet launches decentralized indexing network
events.summary: The Graph launched its decentralized indexing network mainnet.
events.significance: The Graph became core data-query infrastructure for decentralized applications and a major piece of Web3's middleware stack.

events.title: Tornado Cash begins TORN governance-token distribution
events.summary: Tornado Cash began the TORN governance-token distribution/redemption period for eligible early users in December 2020.
events.significance: TORN added tokenized governance to one of Ethereum's most prominent privacy applications, setting up later debates over decentralized governance and sanctions.

sources.title: Tornado Cash Docs — TORN governance token

events.title: 1inch launches 1INCH governance token
events.summary: 1inch released the 1INCH governance and utility token on 25 December 2020 and introduced instant governance for the protocol.
events.significance: The token launch marked 1inch's transition from a DEX aggregation product into a token-governed DeFi network; the aggregator itself originated from a 2019 hackathon.
events.notes: Do not describe 1inch itself as first emerging in 2020; its hackathon origin was in 2019.

events.title: Cover Protocol suffers infinite-mint exploit
events.summary: Cover Protocol's Blacksmith mining contract was exploited through an infinite-mint bug that created an enormous quantity of COVER tokens and collapsed the token price; Cover published a post-mortem the following day.
events.significance: The exploit became a memorable late-DeFi-Summer example of audited-contract logic risk and the fragility of token-reward systems.
